name: YCB-Video (Camera-Relative Pose Sequences)
summary: 92 段 RGB-D 视频提供逐帧物体位姿，物体布局固定而相机移动。
summaryEn: Ninety-two RGB-D videos provide per-frame object poses with fixed object configurations and a moving camera.
scaleZh: 92 段视频；133,827 帧；21 个 YCB 物体
organizations: NVIDIA, University of Washington and Carnegie Mellon University
organizationsZh: NVIDIA、华盛顿大学与卡内基梅隆大学
license: Data, code and asset terms must be checked for the selected release
licenseZh: 所选版本的数据、代码和资产条款须分别核查
access: Paper documents the resource; complete download not tested
accessZh: 论文描述该资源；完整下载未测试
wmNote: 这是相机相对位姿序列，不能作为物体接触动力学标注；年份采用 2017 年预印本。
wmNoteEn: The 92 RGB-D videos include per-frame object poses; annotation estimates camera trajectories while object configurations remain fixed. Suitable for camera-relative pose sequences, not evidence of dynamic object interactions.

evidence.locator: Section IV: dataset and 6D pose annotation
evidence.statement: The 92 RGB-D videos include per-frame object poses; annotation estimates camera trajectories while object configurations remain fixed. Suitable for camera-relative pose sequences, not evidence of dynamic object interactions.
